title: DRE profiles
description: Connections, in `profiles.yml`: database sources and delivery destinations. Kept outside the project (`~/.dre`, `--profiles-dir` or `DRE_PROFILES_DIR`).

sources.description: Database connections, referenced by `default_profile`, `profile:` and Sets.

profile.description: A named connection with one or more targets (environments).

targets.description: The environments of this profile, by name (e.g. `dev`, `prod`).

target.description: One target of a profile: a connection or delivery configuration. `type` names the plugin; every other key is a field of that plugin (see the plugins reference), and secrets belong in `{{ env_var('NAME') }}`.

type.description: The plugin type of the connection, e.g. `duckdb`, `postgres`, `databricks`, `sftp`, `s3`. `local` needs no plugin.
